role: number of literal occurrences of a clause list
notes: Same meaning as the N of def:p02-tractable-classes; size of a clause list is m+N.

role: number of clauses and of occurring variables of a clause list
notes: Used with these roles in sec:p02-w02-p02-019-horn and sec:p02-w02-p02-019-two-sat and their annex items; in sec:p02-w02-p02-019-complexity n is instead the bit length of an input as in def:p02-complexity-standing.

role: set of variables occurring in a clause list S
notes: Assumed renamed p_1..p_n in order of first occurrence.

role: body and head of a Horn clause
notes: B(C) is the set of atoms q with \(\neg q\in C\); the head is the unique positive literal of a definite clause.

role: valuation making exactly the members of X true
notes: X a set of variables; v_F for F the forward closure is the least model.

role: least forward closure of a Horn list
notes: Intersection of the subsets of A_S closed under S; same role as S_* of annex:p14.dc.horn for the circuit instance.

role: arrays and queue of the forward-chaining procedure
notes: Program variables; the array \(\mathit{hd}\) stores the index of \(\operatorname{hd}(C_j)\) or 0. M and D in annex:p02-w02-p02-019-hp are the marked and removed atom sets.

role: implication graph of a 2-CNF list and its reverse
notes: 2n literal vertices and 2m edges counted with repetition; G^R reverses every edge.

role: directed reachability by a path of length 0 or more
notes: Same use as in annex:p04.dh.two-sat; distinct from the scoped P9 role-compatibility relation \(\leadsto_r\).

role: strong component of a vertex
notes: Applied to a vertex; bare C and C' in annex:p02-w02-p02-019-scc are components, while C and C_j elsewhere in the section are clauses. Corresponds to C_L of annex:p04.dh.two-sat.

role: component number and finishing data of the two-pass method
notes: idx is a topological numbering of the condensation; f is the first-pass finishing number; F(C) its maximum on a component; fin the finishing list. h=idx in annex:p02-w02-p02-019-2sat.

role: numbers of vertices and edges of a directed graph
notes: Counts, not vertex or edge sets.

role: truth-table assignment extended by false and the size parameters
notes: k distinct variables, ell total symbol occurrences, r formulas; \(\neg^j\chi\) in annex:p02-w02-p02-019-tt is chi preceded by j negations.

role: certificate predicate for SAT and its auxiliaries
notes: R is the polynomial-time predicate of def:p02-complexity-standing; A is a marker character used only inside the recognizing machine.

role: complement of a language in \(\{0,1\}^*\)
notes: Applied to languages; the registered literal-complement bar applies to literals. Both meanings are complements, of different types.

role: negation map on encodings and the two reductions between TAUT and the complement of SAT
notes: Disjoint in scope from the registered P6 P8 P12 and P3 uses of \(\nu\).

role: coefficients right-hand sides and unknowns of a parity system over the two-element field
notes: m equations and n variables as in def:p02-tractable-classes; x_i is 1 iff p_i is true. x^* is the vector of the returned valuation v^*.

role: current pivot row number of pivots current column and pivot columns of the elimination method
notes: Program variables of the method; r here is a row index, distinct from the formula count r of sec:p02-w02-p02-019-complexity; c is a column index.

role: valuation returned by the elimination method
notes: Pivot variables take the final right-hand side of their row; all others false.

role: unary predicate symbol of the non-terminating resolution example
notes: Example symbols only, in the non-terminating resolution example after thm:p02-w02-p02-019-fol-resolution, as in the example after thm:resolution-lifting.

role: unary function symbol of the non-terminating resolution example
notes: Example symbols only, in the non-terminating resolution example after thm:p02-w02-p02-019-fol-resolution, as in the example after thm:resolution-lifting.

role: constant of the non-terminating resolution example
notes: Example symbols only, in the non-terminating resolution example after thm:p02-w02-p02-019-fol-resolution, as in the example after thm:resolution-lifting.

role: first-order variable of the non-terminating resolution example
notes: Example symbols only, in the non-terminating resolution example after thm:p02-w02-p02-019-fol-resolution, as in the example after thm:resolution-lifting. x here is a first-order variable, not the parity unknown x_i of sec:p02-w02-p02-019-xor.
